#   check    the foundry deck's report categories for it
#   status   agrees | differs | ours_missing | theirs_missing | not_comparable

# Compared on open_pdks' test_violators.gds (held to the foundry deck's own
# findings) and on every sky130_fd_sc_hd cell (held clean).

column5: note

Finding N-f2-2: GPurify flags 22 sky130_fd_sc_hd cells (a2111oi_1 licon at 1.12,0.645) where the li steps out along a licon side: it takes each side's smallest enclosure (75 nm left, 65 nm top), while the foundry deck flags only a licon corner whose two li edges are both short. The cells are foundry-clean, so GPurify is stricter than sign-off.
An mcon outside met1 (test_violators' 6 x 11 nm mcon) is flagged by m1.5 as zero enclosure; the foundry deck leaves it to MR_met1.CON.1 (row m1.4), which both flag.
Both decks flag the 0.29 x 0.23 um met1 pad of tapvgnd_1 and tapvgnd2_1 (0.067 um2 < 0.083): the tap cell is clean only abutting the VGND rail in a row.
